audience.text: Python developers who need to process Word documents programmatically in environments where Microsoft Office is unavailable or prohibited.

capabilities.text: Automatically detects and reads DOCX, DOC (Word 97-2003), RTF, Markdown, and plain text files using dedicated readers.
capabilities.title: Read multiple input formats

capabilities.text: Convert loaded documents to DOCX, Markdown, PDF, or plain text using SaveFormat constants or format-specific save options.
capabilities.title: Export to multiple output formats

capabilities.text: Embed inline, captioned, table, and header/footer images as base64 data URIs in Markdown, render them in PDF via ShapeRenderer, and preserve them losslessly in DOCX round-trips.
capabilities.title: Handle images in documents

capabilities.text: Tune Markdown export with MarkdownSaveOptions, PDF rendering with PdfSaveOptions, and DOCX packaging with OoxmlSaveOptions.
capabilities.title: Configure output formatting

capabilities.text: Extract plain text from any loaded document using Document.get_text() or save directly with SaveFormat.TEXT.
capabilities.title: Extract plain text

limitations.text: SaveFormat.DOC is defined for API compatibility but the library does not implement a DOC writer; saving to DOC raises ValueError.
OoxmlSaveOptions.compliance set to ISO29500_2008_STRICT raises NotImplementedError; only ECMA376_2006 and ISO29500_2008_TRANSITIONAL are implemented.
Eight PdfSaveOptions fields exist for API forward-compatibility but are not consumed by the PDF writer.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic document processing for DOCX, DOC, RTF, Markdown, and plain text formats using a single unified API.
Eliminates dependency on Microsoft Word or COM automation by providing pure-Python readers and writers for common document formats.
Supports round-trip editing of DOCX files while preserving headers, footers, images, bookmarks, and custom styles.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Words FOSS for Python is a free, open-source Python library for reading and writing Word documents without Microsoft Word or COM automation.

uncertainties: The exact behavior of Document.get_text() for Markdown and plain text inputs is not specified beyond extraction capability.
Whether the Light Document Model supports modification of document nodes beyond inspection is not explicitly stated.
The scope of 'lossless' DOCX round-tripping for complex features like macros or embedded OLE objects is not detailed.

workflows.name: Load and convert documents
workflows.text: Construct a Document instance from a file path or stream, then call save() with a SaveFormat constant or save options to export to DOCX, Markdown, PDF, or plain text.

workflows.name: Parse Markdown with structure
workflows.text: Load Markdown files using MarkdownLoadOptions to parse headings, lists, emphasis, tables, code blocks, and embedded images into typed document nodes.

workflows.name: Export to PDF with built-in renderer
workflows.text: Use LdmPdfWriter backed by fpdf2 to render documents to PDF without external engines or system fonts, configurable via PdfSaveOptions.

workflows.name: Inspect and manipulate the document model
workflows.text: Access the parsed Light Document Model through Document.light_document_model to inspect or modify sections, paragraphs, tables, styles, and lists as typed Pydantic models.
